HELP US HELP YOU

For a useful bug report.

  1. Tell us which tool or page you used.
  2. Include your browser, device and the steps you took.
  3. Explain what you expected and what happened.
  4. Share a file format or dimensions for image issues—not private files.

There is no live chat or guaranteed response time. Please don't send passwords, private photos or customer data.
